title: audit detail auth.passkey_remove
description: detail of audit rows with action auth.passkey_remove: passkey used or changed. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.

passkey_id.description: the passkey's audit reference: its b64u credential ID, or sha256:<32 hex> of it when longer than 128 characters (the row's target_id)
